info.title: Start: ai-proxy [--restart] [--key=value | --key value ...]
info.description: A machine-wide local HTTP(S) forward proxy that inspects canonical LLM provider traffic and passes all other destinations through.

commands.name: replay
commands.description:
Replay stored requests through the compression pipeline and show what it would
save

options.name: --minimum
options.description:
The smallest region, in
estimated tokens, that becomes a
preview (default: the proxy's
own)

options.name: --budget-share
options.description:
The share of a region's reduced
tokens a preview may hold, above
0 and at most 1 (default: the
proxy's own)

options.name: --minimum-saving
options.description:
The least a preview must save
over the reduced text, in
estimated tokens (default: the

options.name: --skip-under
options.description:
A numbered read or a diff whose
reduced text is under this many
estimated tokens is not
previewed; 0 turns the skip off
(default: the proxy's own)

options.name: --since
options.description:
Replay only requests from this
date or time on (UTC)

options.name: --source
options.description:
both       Where to read bodies: content,
capture, both

options.name: --include-encoded
options.description:
Replay bodies that carry a
content encoding too; the proxy
never compresses them, so they
are left out by default

options.name: --home
options.description:
The proxy's data directory
(defaults to
Proxy__DataDirectory, then
~/.ai-proxy)
